QuestInfo.name: Om  Noms for Shammos?
QuestInfo.0: Shammos was muttering to himself about something tasty. Alpha and Beta got a bad feeling about it...
QuestInfo.1: Dragon eggs are what Shammos wanted to eat. Shammos looks like it can devour an egg whole. Go get #r#t4000921##k and give it to Shammos as if it was a dragon egg before something awful happens.
QuestInfo.2: You tricked Shammos to believing  that #t4000921# is a dragon egg. Luckily #t4000921# must have tasted bad. It seems like Shammos no longer wants to eat dragon eggs.

1.0: Is this really a Dragon egg? Finally! I can taste one of these delicacies! Let me take a bite! Nom!

default.0: If you don't bring me a Dragon Egg, I'll eat THAT egg. Don't you think I won't do it. I really will!
